fact: Minister Doumba says companies have been created online at ANPI for 4 or 5 years, with close to 50,000 companies created, and that CNSS and CNAMGS declarations are expected to follow online.
Techies reports Gabon's DGDI inaugurated an e-services portal where citizens can renew passports, national ID cards and residence permits online (three services named).
Techies reports that since July 2024 a citizen with a valid passport can apply online for the CNIE on the DGDI site edgdi.dgdi.ga using their NIP.

Vice-president of the government Hermann Immongault presented the Gabon Connect single digital window on 22 October 2026, with the Declaration unique des salaires and TresorPay portals deployed in a phase due to finish in December 2027.

GabonMediaTime says the Gabon Connect platform was set up in March 2026 to put tax, customs, land and social security procedures online, with a single payroll declaration and TresorPay modules still being prepared.
